description: Dependency updates as PRs against dev (the default branch), once a week. See AGENTS.md, Dependencies.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of dev tooling in one PR.
Node majors move together: .node-version (the single source), package.json engines and @types/node.
Node minors and patches need no change: .node-version holds only the major.
Vue and its tooling move together.
The bundled icons are generated from Nuxt UI's and Lucide's.
prBodyNotes: Run `npm run icons:lucide` on this branch and commit the result; a unit test fails until the bundled icons match.

packageRules.description: The mana font is a generated subset.
prBodyNotes: Run `npm run fonts:mana` on this branch and commit `app/assets/css/mana.css` and `app/assets/fonts/mana.woff2`.

packageRules.description: Playwright's browsers come with the package.
prBodyNotes: Run `npx playwright install chromium` locally before `npm run test:e2e`.
